title: Therapist Pilot Access Control Matrix
description: Role-Based and Attribute-Based Access Control Specification for the Therapist Pilot environment enforcing Least Privilege.

THERAPIST_PILOT_USER.description: Authorized clinical therapist participating in the internal pilot. Access restricted to advisory queries, synthetic note processing, and evidence viewing.
THERAPIST_PILOT_USER.least_privilege_scope: Read-only access to GraphRAG advisor endpoints scoped strictly to own pilot_id and active session.

CLINICAL_REVIEWER.description: Member of the Clinical Governance Board responsible for evaluating novel insights, review feedback, and safety compliance.
CLINICAL_REVIEWER.least_privilege_scope: Read-access to pilot interaction logs, candidate novelty queue, and review sign-off endpoints.

CONTENT_REVIEWER.description: Domain expert responsible for auditing clinical knowledge accuracy, evidence citations, and knowledge graph node quality.
CONTENT_REVIEWER.least_privilege_scope: Read access to staging knowledge graph and evidence provenance data; approval rights on candidate knowledge updates.

SYSTEM_OPERATOR.description: Technical system administrator managing system health, feature flags, deployment pipelines, and service availability.
SYSTEM_OPERATOR.least_privilege_scope: Administrative access to feature flags, infrastructure telemetry, service lifecycle, and operational metrics. Zero access to raw query content.

SECURITY_AUDITOR.description: Independent security and compliance officer monitoring audit trails, security policy enforcement, and incident logs.
SECURITY_AUDITOR.least_privilege_scope: Read-only access to immutable audit log streams, security alert dashboards, and policy compliance verification tools.

resources_and_endpoints.description: Ephemeral summarization of anonymized session notes
Read-only query of approved clinical knowledge graph
Mutate knowledge graph (Create/Update/Delete nodes or edges)
conditions: EXPLICIT_DENY_IN_PILOT: Knowledge graph mutations prohibited during pilot execution.

resources_and_endpoints.description: View and manage novel insight candidates staging queue
Read immutable audit logs and safety event trails
Toggle master pilot feature flag and safety switches
System performance, error rates, and health metrics

session_and_token_policies.revocation_mechanism: Redis-backed Token Blacklist with instant propagation

isolation_rules.pilot_id_isolation: All database queries, vector searches, and cache lookups MUST include `pilot_id` in the filter predicate. Cross-pilot_id data access returns 403 Forbidden.
isolation_rules.session_isolation: LLM interaction memory buffers are bound strictly to `session_id`. Memory buffers are destroyed upon session logout or 15-minute inactivity timeout.
isolation_rules.network_isolation: Pilot API runtime runs in an isolated network namespace with zero outbound access to external public IP addresses.
